samples.question: The gray dashed bar at the top is a pattern of solid dashes separated by empty gaps. Below it are three colored dashed bars: one is red, one is green, and one is blue, and each has a different dash-to-gap ratio (how long each solid dash is compared to the empty gap to its right). Which colored bar has exactly the same dash-to-gap ratio as the gray bar? Answer red, green, or blue.
